{{Quote|Any systems nearby?''"<br />"''Closest one's about a quarter light-year directly ahead.|Dubrak Qennto and Maris Ferasi|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
An [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] '''star system''' with a [[Unidentified yellow sun|yellow sun]] was situated around 250 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from the border of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'' arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] after it had been stranded in the Unknown Regions by a malfunctioning [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] during a [[Skirmish between Progga and the Bargain Hunter|pursuit]] by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Progga's starship]].

[[Progga]] followed the ''Bargain Hunter'' to the system; however, the two [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were then [[Skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two|intercepted]] by a [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] [[Picket Force Two/Legends|unit]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], also [[Core name/Legends|known]] as Thrawn. Disabling the ''Bargain Hunter'' and destroying Progga's ship, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] invited the crew of the former aboard Thrawn's [[Springhawk/Legends|cruiser]], where the ''Bargain Hunter''{{'s}} crewmembers made first contact with the Chiss. The Chiss subsequently took the ''Bargain Hunter'' and its crew for closer inspection at their base in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]].

==Description==
{{Quote|You figure out yet where we are, Maris?''"<br />"''Computer's still working on it. But it looks like we're about two hundred fifty light-years into Unknown Space.|Dubrak Qennto and Maris Ferasi|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
A [[Star system/Legends|star system]] with a small [[Unidentified yellow sun|yellow sun]] was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], approximately 250 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from that region's border with [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Outbound" />

==History==
===Out of Hutt clutches&hellip;===
{{Quote|This is the lone star system along this vector; and behold, you are here. What could you have run to but a secret base and treasure hoard?|Progga, to Dubrak Qennto|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
[[File:BargainHunterJump-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The star system was the closest to the point where the ''Bargain Hunter'' emerged from a blind hyperspace jump into the Unknown Regions.]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', crewed by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dubrak Qennto]], [[Maris Ferasi]], and [[Jorj Car'das]], was transporting a shipment of [[firegem]]s intended for<ref name="Outbound" /> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="CSWE Drixo">{{CSWECite|I|208|Drixo the Hutt}}</ref> [[Drixo]]. The latter's rival, [[Progga]], attempted to hijack the shipment, [[Skirmish between Progga and the Bargain Hunter|pursuing]] Qennto's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in his [[Progga's starship|own starship]]. During the chase, Car'das, not having the [[Time/Legends|time]] to plot a proper [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump for the ''Bargain Hunter'' to use to escape its pursuer, instead suggested to Qennto a course randomly aimed at the largest apparent area with no visible [[Star/Legends|stars]] in it. As a result, the freighter jumped from the edges of known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] toward the Unknown Regions, where problems with the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] eventually left it stranded.<ref name="Outbound" />

Qennto, claiming to dislike interstellar space, inquired as to the proximity of any nearby star systems. Ferasi replied by pointing out the system with the yellow sun due to it being the nearest to their position at only approximately a quarter of a light-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] further along their jump vector. Reasoning that the system could potentially have [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that could serve them as a source of supplies&mdash;and, not completely sincerely, wondering whether it could also serve as a temporary place of refuge for them from life in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space&mdash;Qennto [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ship to the system by using its [[backup hyperdrive]].<ref name="Outbound" />

===&hellip;into the arms of Chiss===
{{Quote|The base isn't far.&raquo;''<br />''&laquo;Is it in this system? Sorry, sorry&mdash;none of my business.&raquo;''<br />''&laquo;True. However, it will do no harm to tell you that it's in a different system entirely.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Dubrak Qennto|<ref name="Outbound" />|translated=1}}
[[File:Outboundthrawn.jpg|thumb|right|250px|In the star system, the crew of the ''Bargain Hunter'' made first contact with the Chiss, including Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo (pictured).]]
Shortly after the ''Bargain Hunter'' arrived in the system, Progga also arrived there. The gangster believed that the system's lonely location along the freighter's vector indicated that Qennto had traveled toward a hidden base where he maintained a cache of treasure, and Progga promptly demanded that the captain lead him to that facility. Unnoticed by the two vessels, three ships of [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], also [[Core name/Legends|known]] as Thrawn, were also present in the system. The lead [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] ship, the [[Cruiser/Legends|attack cruiser]] [[Springhawk/Legends|''Springhawk'']], monitored the transmissions between Progga's vessel and the ''Bargain Hunter'' while the Chiss force positioned itself to intercept the two ships. The Chiss used a [[Conner net|shock net]] to disable the light freighter and set one of their [[Chiss fighter|smaller craft]] to guard it. Meanwhile, Progga's ship initiated a [[Skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two|fight]] in which the Chiss soon destroyed the vessel.<ref name="Outbound" />

The ''Bargain Hunter'' was then invited to approach the ''Springhawk'', with the former's crew boarding the latter and meeting Thrawn. The two parties introduced themselves to each other; Thrawn inquired as to the identity and purpose of arrival of both Qennto's crew and Progga's ship. Thrawn then informed the Humans that the Chiss would be taking their freighter to Picket Force Two's base for closer inspection. To Qennto's question whether the facility was located inside the same system they were in Thrawn responded in the negative, and during the conversation the Chiss vessels made a hyperspace jump to the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]], the site of the base.<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star system appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' indirectly placed the system in grid square I-7.<ref name="Grid" />
